svg.text: Each thing on the house means one thing, and it is always in the same place.
Each floor has 6 spots. Left to right they are:
knight, bishop, queen, king, bishop, knight
(the same order the pieces start in on the board).
The house's colour and wall pattern tell you the
opening family. The roof tells you White's first
move. The trim colour (window frames, door,
gutter) tells you which version of the opening.
